`C:\Vortex Services\go-lib` (Go 1.25). Follow root `AGENTS.md`; module rules override it: `foundation/AGENTS.md` `security/AGENTS.md` `transport/AGENTS.md` `data/AGENTS.md` `runtime/AGENTS.md` `messaging/AGENTS.md`. Run checks per module (not `go test ./...` from workspace root).
for m in foundation security transport data runtime messaging/kafka/franzgo messaging/kafka/schemaregistry; do
(cd "$m" && go build ./...)
for m in foundation security transport data runtime messaging/kafka/franzgo messaging/kafka/schemaregistry; do
(cd "$m" && go test -count=1 ./...)
(cd foundation && go test -count=1 -tags unit ./...)
(cd runtime && go test -count=1 -tags unit ./...)
(cd data && go test -count=1 -tags "unit testhooks" ./postgres)
for m in foundation security transport data runtime messaging/kafka/franzgo messaging/kafka/schemaregistry; do
(cd "$m" && go vet ./...)
Integration tests use Docker infrastructure for Postgres, Redis, and Redpanda. Race checks should run in Docker using `golang:1.25.7` when local CGO toolchain is unavailable. Keep public API backward-compatible unless task explicitly requires breaking changes. Keep functions nil-safe at module boundaries where contexts/pointers may be nil. Prefer deterministic behavior and explicit validation errors. Do not add new external dependencies unless strictly required. If exported behavior changes, update relevant README files. Workflows: `.github/workflows/integration-race.yml`. Any change to build/test process should update both this file and workflow definitions.
